toolsHub.title: Free Social Media Tools | Instagram, TikTok & Facebook
toolsHub.description: Use free NovaLikes tools for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, including video downloaders, profile viewers and public profile checks.

instagram-profile-picture-viewer.title: Instagram Profile Picture Viewer – Full Size | NovaLikes
instagram-profile-picture-viewer.description: View and download the publicly available Instagram profile picture in full size. Enter a username or public profile URL. No Instagram login needed.

instagram-follower-counter.title: Instagram Follower Count Checker – Free | NovaLikes
instagram-follower-counter.description: Check the follower count Instagram makes publicly available for a profile. Enter a username or public profile URL. No Instagram login required.

instagram-profile-viewer.title: Instagram Profile Viewer – Public Profiles | NovaLikes
instagram-profile-viewer.description: View publicly available Instagram profile details including photo, bio, followers, following and post count. No Instagram login required.

instagram-video-downloader.title: Instagram Video Downloader – Public Videos | NovaLikes
instagram-video-downloader.description: Paste a public Instagram post or Reel URL to check for downloadable video media when Instagram exposes it. No Instagram login required.

tiktok-video-downloader.title: Free TikTok Video Downloader – MP4 | NovaLikes
tiktok-video-downloader.description: Paste a public TikTok video URL to find available MP4 download options. No TikTok login or app is required. Availability can vary by video.

tiktok-profile-picture-downloader.title: TikTok Profile Picture Downloader – Full Size | NovaLikes
tiktok-profile-picture-downloader.description: View and download a publicly available TikTok profile picture in full size. Enter a username, @handle or public profile URL. No TikTok login needed.

facebook-video-downloader.title: Facebook Video Downloader – Free HD & SD | NovaLikes
facebook-video-downloader.description: Paste a public Facebook video URL to find available HD or SD download options. No Facebook login or app is required for supported public videos.

facebook-reels-downloader.title: Facebook Reels Downloader – Free HD & SD | NovaLikes
facebook-reels-downloader.description: Paste a public Facebook Reel URL to find available HD or SD download options. No Facebook login or app is required for supported public Reels.
